content: k3s homelab backup norms: GitOps repo itself is the primary recovery mechanism (rebuild = fresh k3s + ArgoCD + sync, ~30min reported). Velero adds PV/state backup but needs an S3 target (MinIO considered overkill for single node; Garage suggested as lightweight alt). For a design with all state OUTSIDE k8s (LXC Postgres etc.), Velero is largely unnecessary — Proxmox VM/LXC snapshots + pg_dump cover state, and the cluster is disposable by design. Expected baseline: automated Proxmox backups of LXCs + logical DB dumps + git as source of truth.
